honest_limit.gallic.limit.no-one-who-saw-him: One of our own knew, in person, a man who had seen Jesus walk the earth.

honest_limit.ijc.limit.reading-alone: One of our own left a written account of how scripture once frightened and confused him personally.

honest_limit.rzg.limit.what-scripture-asked-of-a-mode: Our own record reflects directly on the violence in scripture and what a modern reader might find troubling in it.
